Energy leaks steadily as the customer has to repeat the same clarification with rising specificity until they disengage entirely.
outcome_dispute: This is not a standard DQ or objection call — it's a non-standard scenario (existing solar customer needing removal/reinstall service only) that the rep never routed correctly, so 'no_appointment' is the right tag but the root cause is scope-mismatch, not typical objection handling failure.
